versions.notes: Faster deep search: about twice as fast with exactly the same builds (checked on every class, and every number of 2,000 test builds compared with the previous version). The fine-tuning, the deeper search, the shake-ups and the crafted items for the best builds now run side by side on all your CPU cores, and the scoring maths is quicker.

The bot knows your characters: say "make my shaman tankier" or use a character's name and it uses that character's class, level and gear; it can also level up characters and save builds to them. Goal mix: mostly one goal plus some of another (e.g. 70% spell damage + 30% survival). Mana check for spell builds: whether you can cast at full speed forever, or for how long. Armor powders are now part of the best build (they add health, so tanky builds get stronger).

Home page and character library: the app opens on your characters. Pick a class, then a character, to see its saved builds and make a new build for it (class, level and gear filled in). When a build is ready, a big banner asks whether to save it to a character's library. Characters and libraries stay on your computer and updates never touch them.

Crafted items: the search now designs crafted items for your build (recipe, tier 3 materials, attack speed, and the six ingredients and where each goes) and uses them wherever they beat normal items, for every class and slot. Every craft follows the game's crafting rules. The report and a new "How to craft" panel show each recipe, where the ingredients drop, and a link to Wynnbuilder's crafter. Untick "Design crafted items" (or tell the bot) to leave them out. Also: tests/run_all.py runs every check at once on all your CPU cores.

Automatic checks: every update is now tested on Windows before it's offered, including the app itself, the updater (your key, settings and history stay untouched), and a full build for every class that must be legal and never worse than before. A version that fails any check never reaches the update bar.

Ability buffs now checked for every class: each of the 53 toggles (Archer 8, Warrior 9, Mage 5, Assassin 16, Shaman 15) is tested at fully on and part on, and buffs that don't scale evenly are now worked out exactly instead of estimated. The report lists which buffs the build counts, and shows small gains as e.g. +0.2% instead of +0%.

Ability buffs counted honestly: the best Mystic Mask, Coursing Restraints for the share of time it can be up, and ultimate buffs at the same share as ultimate damage. Buffs with unknown timing stay off; you can turn any on, even for part of the time ("Contamination=70%"). The report says which toggles to tick in Wynnbuilder to match.
Switch versions in Settings: go back to an earlier version if an update causes problems, and forward again any time. The update bar always offers the newest version.
